Zero Gravity Massage Chairs Explained

Zero gravity is a reclined position with your legs raised to about the level of your heart, so your weight spreads across the seat and back. Makers say it is based on NASA research into the body's relaxed posture in space. NASA itself says there is no single zero gravity posture, only a range, and claims that the position boosts circulation or recovery are mostly manufacturer claims, not tested in massage chair studies.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
